column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline rules: IGNORE / WARN / FAIL per rule id. Everything not listed fails.
# 10049 is "Non-Storable Content": the HTML pages are deliberately not cached.
# 10027 "Information Disclosure - Suspicious Comments": the HTML carries code comments on purpose.
# 10050 "Retrieved from Cache": CloudFront serving cached files is the point of the CDN.
# 10015 "Re-examine Cache-control Directives": pages are public and sent with max-age=0, must-revalidate on purpose.
# 10094 "Base64 Disclosure": the CSP's sha256 hashes and the font/asset fingerprints, not secrets.
# 10202 "Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens": the letter form posts to Google Apps Script; the site has no sessions or cookies to forge.
# 90004 "Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy": require-corp would block the embedded Google Calendar.
# 90005 "Sec-Fetch-Dest Header is Missing": about ZAP's own requests, not something a server sends.
